company.name: BabRizk
company.shortDescription: BabRizk is a staffing and recruiting firm that specializes in hiring and retaining of blue-collar workers for corporate organizations.
company.description: BabRizk is a recruitment platform designed to connect employers directly to blue-collar workers. It offers direct access to a large pool of workers, prioritizing them based on direct job match, proximity, and ratings with a touch of a button, providing employers the ability to hire and pay seasonal or temporary workers through the application and allowing workers to avail a wider scope of financial inclusion.
